title: Trump threatens to abolish birthright citizenship through Congress after supreme court rules against him – live
summary:
President reacts to ruling to uphold birthright citizenship after justices strike down executive order aimed at ending longstanding principle
Supreme court upholds birthright citizenship
, allows states to ban
trans women from female sports
and ends
limits on federal campaign spending
What to know about birthright citizenship – explained

The supreme court’s decision to reject Trump’s attempt to fire Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook yesterday is part of a long-running battle
over the independence of the central bank.
Trump repeatedly attacked former chair Jerome Powell for not lowering interest rates fast enough, calling him a “moron” on social media. Powell’s term ended in May this year, and he was succeeded by Trump nominee Kevin Warsh.
